description: Use when asked to audit, prune or consolidate the whole set of skills a session is offered, across plugin, hub, project and repo sources. Finds overlapping or contradictory skills, shadowing, same-name drift, visibility mistakes, broken ../ closure and listing-budget truncation, ranks fixes and gives necessity verdicts. Not for reviewing one skill (hoa-skill-review), provenance or upstream freshness (hoa-skill-curate), reviewing one repo's practices (the explicit hoa-repo-reckoning shortcut), or editing skills.
